title: Phone-access wording
responsibility: Format connection, identity, permission and lock-state wording for phone access.

inputs.name: relayName.origin
inputs.description: Relay origin to display; invalid URLs produce an empty label.

inputs.name: timeLeft.milliseconds
inputs.description: Remaining milliseconds; rounded up to seconds and clamped at zero.

inputs.name: keyLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: Device ID whose first 12 characters are grouped in fours.

inputs.name: identityLabel.deviceId
inputs.description: Full device ID to group in fours.

inputs.name: grantLabel.grant
inputs.description: Grant whose agents flag determines permission wording.

inputs.name: grantSummary.grant
inputs.description: Grant containing project list and agents flag.

inputs.name: hostLine.status
inputs.description: Host status used for relay and connection-state wording.

inputs.name: hostSummary.status
inputs.description: Host status used for enabled state and approved-phone count.

inputs.name: remoteLabels.status
inputs.description: Mobile connection status used for heading and supporting text.

outputs.name: lockNote
outputs.description: Explanation that approved phones work while the computer is locked and awake, but not asleep.

outputs.name: lockedNote
outputs.description: Wording for a locked, awake computer.

outputs.name: unlockedNote
outputs.description: Wording for an unlocked, awake computer.

outputs.name: approveNote
outputs.description: Instruction to approve the phone on the computer.

outputs.name: awayNote
outputs.description: Explanation that an offline computer is asleep or disconnected and nothing is sent until it returns.

outputs.name: revokedNote
outputs.description: Instruction to pair again after revocation.

outputs.name: relayName
outputs.description: Relay host and optional port, or an empty string for an invalid URL.

outputs.name: grantLabel
outputs.description: Plan and Change allowed, or Read and comment only.

outputs.name: grantSummary
outputs.description: Project count followed by permission wording.

outputs.name: hostLine
outputs.description: Phone-access-on line with relay and applicable registering, connecting or offline suffix.

outputs.name: hostSummary
outputs.description: Phone access off, or the approved-phone count.

outputs.name: remoteLabels
outputs.description: Heading and supporting text for the mobile state, using host name and lock state where available.
